doc: Reviewed staged surface: each exported symbol without a statically visible production consumer names either one exact canonical open plan step that retires it or a closed evidence-bound retained classification. Missing, blocked, historical, duplicate, and free-text future-work entries refuse. Undeclared new unconsumed surface still blocks the gate.

staged.name: NewTextTransform
staged.reason: Explicit target-case profiles are exercised by real CTC publication/resume acceptance. The served CPU lifecycle must select and publish the profile through its production training assembly, preserving raw source text.

staged.name: PublishInputProjection
staged.reason: Real CPU acceptance publishes adapter-only Safetensors with the universal checkpoint owner. The served CPU lifecycle must consume this boundary in production training; acceptance alone does not establish a training command or promotion path.

staged.name: RestoreInputProjection
staged.reason: Fresh-process CTC acceptance proves exact restoration through the shared optimizer and stream owners. The served CPU lifecycle must integrate this boundary into production training and interruption recovery.

staged.name: CandidateExecution
staged.reason: Shared testing.TB fixture consolidates duplicate candidate-compilation helpers from runtime and media tests; it is test-consumed by design and adds no serving API. The bound finding records the consumers, passing scoped checks and 32-node duplication reduction.

staged.name: OpenAudioStream
staged.reason: Bounded chunk, cancellation and restart contracts precede the audio campaign's native recognizer integration. Retire this declaration when the verified native-state consumer lands; session contract tests alone do not establish native streaming parity.

staged.name: RequireWithin
staged.reason: Shared max-abs-diff tolerance gate consolidating the per-package golden-test copies; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: RequireElementsWithin
staged.reason: Shared first-divergent-element tolerance gate consolidating hostmath and seriesforecast golden checks; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: ModelArtifactDir
staged.reason: Shared model-directory resolver for artifact-gated golden tests, consolidating the per-package copies; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: GGUFScalar
staged.reason: Shared hermetic GGUF fixture metadata builder consolidating the inference and trainingworkflow copies; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: GGUFArray

staged.name: GGUFTensorF32
staged.reason: Shared hermetic GGUF fixture tensor builder consolidating the inference and trainingworkflow copies; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: CountingRepository
staged.reason: Shared commit-counting wrapper proving one-batch semantic transitions across runrecord, workflowruntime, and modelrecipe; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: ContentVisitor
staged.reason: Optional batch-visit capability interface the batched reader detects.

staged.name: ContentPresence
staged.reason: Optional presence-batch capability interface for mixed evidence lists.

staged.name: ForbidVocabularyRedefinition
staged.reason: Anti-fork scanner keeping canonical vocabularies from being restated per package; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.

staged.name: PublishModelDefinition
staged.reason: Shared cross-package model-definition fixture replaces divergent descriptor-only test setup; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.
